criteria.keep_query_file_gap: Retain the integer-key query form page at /invoices/form?tenant_id=1&invoice_id=7, add the grid shell at /invoice-grid?tenant=1&invoice=7, and record the captured /tenants/:t/invoices/:i/edit URL as a plan gap for a follow-up task that owns the checker. The browser skip gate keeps passing, no route is hardcoded, and every served route stays inside the checked language.
criteria.static_hardcode: Serve the /edit URL through static routes, one per invoice the fixture touches. Punts on the capture problem but hardcodes fixture identities into the route table and answers malformed integers with 404 instead of the required 400.
criteria.unchecked_emitter_route: Teach the emitter to synthesize a captured page route the checker never validated. Serves the acceptance URL shape but routes around the checked language, so capture typing and ambiguity diagnostics no longer cover the page.

page_scope.instructions: Given the frozen checker and the integer-only skip gate, how should this work package scope the two served pages?

criteria.createhtml_argument: Append an optional fourth createHTML parameter carrying the swap table; the emitter passes it only when a program declares HTML POST actions, mirroring the existing declared-URL parameter. Explicit data flow, no shared mutable state, byte-identical output for programs without HTML actions.
criteria.mount_registration: Have each HTML action mount register its path and policy into the HTML runtime when routes are built. No emitter change, but assertion runs render pages without mounting, so asserts would observe policy-free markup while live traffic observes policy-bearing markup.
criteria.shared_registry: Add a runtime module registry fed by generated program initialization. Keeps createHTML untouched but introduces implicit global state plus init-order coupling between the state module and the HTML factory.

plumbing.instructions: How should the per-program swap table travel from emitted output into the HTML string renderer?

criteria.element_derivation: Extend the runtime HTML element serializer: when it sees an hx-post or hx-get attribute whose local URL structurally matches an HTML POST action from an emitter-supplied table, it appends exact hx-status attributes for that action's declared non-2xx swap cases. No new Can API; authors cannot forge policy; plain URLs keep byte-identical output.
criteria.explicit_api: Add a new catalogue function that accepts the action and returns the exception attributes. Expresses intent in source but action symbols are not values, so checking it needs a fifth action consumer in files this lane must not touch; defers the feature to a checker-owning task.
criteria.omit_producer: Ship the pages with no swap exceptions and document that validation feedback never swaps. Smallest change, but the declared 422 invalid case would stay invisible on action-bound forms, contradicting the acceptance gate.

producer.instructions: Which mechanism should supply hx-status swap exceptions for forms bound to checked HTML actions?

criteria.precheck_shell: Mirror the form page: parse the query keys, authenticate the cookie, and serve 403 or 503 notices for denied or unavailable loads. Consistent with the form page but duplicates a policy the browser application must implement anyway for mid-session revocation.
criteria.public_shell: Serve the grid shell unconditionally with HTTP 200 and no query parsing or session lookup; the browser application validates its keys and renders API denials itself. The shell carries no invoice data, so nothing leaks, and the server validates only what it consumes.

shell_auth.instructions: Should the served grid shell authenticate and parse, or stay public while the browser application owns denial UX?

constraints: This lane owns the invoice server web/render sources and the invoice Go/browser tests. compiler/internal/check is frozen, the shared contract is read-only, and no new route, action, callback, or generic checking machinery may be added.
Every success and error fragment must be a real application renderer; no helper may be a placeholder. Assertion runs and live serving must observe identical rendering behavior.
A clean rebuild with identical inputs must yield identical bytes. Programs without HTML actions should keep byte-identical emitted output where practical.
evidence: The vendored htmx answers each response status by scanning the exact code first: an hx-status:422 attribute merges its swap spec before the 4xx noSwap entry can suppress the swap. Exact attributes therefore re-admit declared cases despite the global 4xx/5xx entries.

The shared contract marks every save_invoice_html case, including 409, 403, and 503, as swap inner. The served form posts to that action through htmx::post(action::url(...)) with hx-target and hx-swap already set.
The Go browser test skips unless the harness source contains the literal tenant_id, which only the integer-key query page shape satisfies. Plain non-action forms must keep swapping nothing on 422.

The paired server splices exactly one module script tag ahead of </body> in served HTML documents; a dependency-free browser fixture is explicitly allowed to pair while the grid migrates, and the empty intersection passes the shared-lock check.

The HTML attribute vocabulary is closed: authors cannot construct hx-status attributes through textAttribute or any htmx producer, and element() is the single serialization choke point. createHTML already accepts a plumbed declared-URL list from the emitter.
state.project: UP19 binds the real invoice server handlers and serves both application pages: the HTMX form page and the grid shell page. Plain routes accept static paths only, GET actions answer JSON only, and captured HTML pages are not expressible in the checked language today.
